notes.title: ROOMS Update + New Game Modes
notes.content:
MAZE is Evolving!

From day one we started developing new features to allow you to fully enjoy this experience.

Below the list of changes made:

Maze's Rooms:
The number of rooms in the maze has been increased. Now you will find rooms of different sizes, of different styles and all procedurally generated.
This will allow you to experience the labyrinth in a way never seen before.
Explore every single room for chests or keys and remember their locations to improve your sense of direction.

Game modes:
Replaced previous game modes with 4 New Modes:

Classic: An endless mode that will allow you to challenge increasingly larger mazes where you will have to extricate yourself from traps and increasingly numerous of monsters level after level.
Safe: No traps or creatures that can harm you, choose how big the maze is and explore it until you find the exit.
Only Homo Octopus: Choose the size of the maze and immerse yourself in this dangerous adventure, but be careful you will not be alone. Can you find the end of the maze by hiding from the lord of this land?
Run Against Time: *Under Development* Choose the size of maze and start running, can you find the end of the maze before the time runs out?


New items
Now in the new maze's rooms you can find some interesting items:

Arrow: Take a look at where they point, they could indicate what you are looking for.
Altar of Sacrifice: You will be offered a spell, but at what price?
Health Pool: Collect the goblets and all your life points will be restored.
Mimic: Each chest has a low chance of containing a creature inside that will attack you.


Minor Changes

Starting Spell: The aesthetics of the first spell selector have been changed.
Crystal Vessel: Changed the aesthetics of the Crystal Vessel in the Hub.
Time wall: Changed the time wall to save the times for each new mode, a button will allow you to navigate to see the times of each mode. In addition, the date on which the run is performed will also be saved.
Limbo: Implemented a new area where the player will be teleported at the end of the game.
Crystal: Changed the aesthetics of the crystal, now it gives off its own light:
Homo Octopus: Now the Homo Octopus spawns after a few seconds and if killed it will reappear after another few seconds.



We also remind you that this is just the beginning, MAZE: A VR Adventure still has a lot to offer, including the "Run Against Time" game mode which we plan to release within the next month.

If you find any bug or problem please email us at glgames0220@gmail.com, it would help us a lot!

Waiting for the next evolution:

Fell free to get Lost.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Changes

 Monsters now drop spell when slayed.
 To activate the spell selector it is no longer necessary to look at the palm of your hand, now you have to press the trigger on the hand with which you are not holding the wand.
 The description of the spells in the hub is now available from the beginning. It is no longer necessary to find them in the maze to unlock the spell's descriptions.
 Passing through the labyrinth, you will no longer leave a trace of your passage. This ability has been added as a new spell.
 It is no longer necessary to grab the crystal at the end of the maze or the crystals at the tutorial or credits section. Now you just need to touch them to activate the teleport to the HUB.


Bug Fix

 Fixed credits' crystal teleport.
 Axe trap sound increased.
 Fixed a bug that didn't load the Russian language at the start of the game.



We are also working on two new features:

 A big update regarding the maze's rooms.
 Mana system to manage spells.
